Basic Information

  • Full Project Title: Mechanochemistry & Mechanical Processing – Supramolecular Materials
  • Host Institution: University of Birmingham
  • Department: School of Chemistry
  • Supervisor: Prof. Tomislav Friscic
  • Partner: Defence Science and Technology Laboratory (Dstl)
  • Study Level: PhD
  • Duration: 4 years
  • Start Date: 2026/27
  • Funding Type: Fully Funded
  • Eligibility: UK and international students (EU, Canada, Australia, USA)
  • Application Deadline: Open (as of late July 2026)
  • Contact: Birmingham Centre for Mechanochemistry and Mechanical Processing

Project Description

This 4-year PhD project focuses on reactivity in supramolecular materials and related mechanochemistry projects, in collaboration with the UK Defence Science and Technology Laboratory (Dstl). The project is open to UK and international students from the EU, Canada, Australia, and the USA. Exact funding details are available on enquiry.

How to Apply

Contact the group via the School of Chemistry / Birmingham Centre for Mechanochemistry and Mechanical Processing to discuss fit and application steps.
